Each fixture folder holds one real drawing set and a hand-checked answer_key.yaml (same format as
fixture_01). Use the `/add-fixture <folder>` Claude Code command to draft a new answer key, then
check every value against the PDF yourself.

Still needed before M3: a single detached house, a two-storey house, a subdivision of separate
dwellings, and a set that includes a 3D perspective page.
